description: Gorgias is an ecommerce customer support and conversational AI platform that unifies helpdesk channels such as email, chat, voice, SMS, and social messaging. It lets merchants manage support operations, automation, analytics, and app integrations from a tenant-specific Gorgias account.
summary: Gorgias exposes a tenant-scoped REST API on `https://{domain}.gorgias.com/api` authenticated by either HTTP Basic with a user API key or OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens, plus a remote MCP server at `https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp` authenticated by browser-based Gorgias authorization.
